7.description: Holy Radiance now heals targets affected by Renew for 30%, up from 20%, of the effective healing done by your healing abilities.
Shatter now has updated tooltip clarifying that the effect only works for spells cast before your Frostbolt hits the target.
Death or Glory no longer removes health after the effect finishes.
Fixed Rain of Fire (Fire Storm), Blizzard (Hailstorm), and Volley (Rain of Arrows) to no longer stop doing damage if you go out of line of sight of the target location.
[NEW EPIC ENCHANT]: Lurking Shadow. Increases your threat generated by Shadow damage by 25%.

[NEW EPIC ENCHANT]: Guerilla Tactics. Your Sniper Training is now supplemented with Guerilla Training, now also increasing the damage of your Mongoose Bite, Raptor Strike and Counterattack by 9%. Requires the final rank of Sniper Training.

[NEW EPIC ENCHANT]: Munitions Expert. Your guns now use armor-piercing rounds, dealing 15% more physical damage but increasing the time between shots by 20%. Your bows and crossbows now fire quick-draw arrows, firing 30% faster but dealing 10% less physical damage.
[NEW EPIC ENCHANT]: Sword and Thunder. Your Sword and Board talent now resets the cooldown and reduces the rage cost of Thunderclap instead of Shield Slam.

[NEW EPIC ENCHANT]: Zephyr. Dealing damage with Windfury inspires you with the Wrath of Al'Akir, increasing your attack speed 1%. This effect stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 10 seconds. When reaching 10 stacks, your next Windfury will consume the stacks and trigger two extra attacks.

[NEW LEGENDARY ENCHANT]: Undaunted. Casting Victory Rush while Stagger is active reduces the cooldown of your Last Stand by 30 seconds. Activating Last Stand removes Stagger, but its health bonus is reduced to 10% and duration reduced to 10 seconds.

[NEW EPIC ENCHANT]: Covering Crown. When cast in Tree Form, your Rejuvenation also reduces the targets damage taken from area of effect attacks by 30% for 3 seconds. This does not stack with other similar effects.
[NEW EPIC ENCHANT]: Bright Lights. Your Light's Grace talent now also triggers from Holy Fire and grants 3% spell haste while active.
[NEW EPIC ENCHANT]': Good Fortune. Consuming a fully-stacked Serendipity increases your Holy spell critical strike chance by 5% for 8 seconds.
Power Overwhelming has been moved to Epic, and now reduces the cooldown by 2s, down from 3s.
Unrelenting Wrath can now also proc on Hunter Melee ability critical strikes.

On the Hunt now increases damage done by your pet by 10%, up from 5%, Threat reduction to 30% up from 15%, and now reduces the mana cost of Mend Pet by 50%. Duration of On the Hunt has been increased to 4s, up from 3s per .

Fixed a typo in the tooltip of Serendipity.

Froststorm Breath now deals 50% reduced damage to players, from 30%.
All tamed beast family abilities now scales with the pets attack power.
Raid buff auras will no longer fall off without reapplying when you die or enter arena matches.

Added capstone to the Pyromaniac talent granting a 20% threat reduction that does not stack with similar capstone bonuses.
Added capstone to the Two-Handed Weapon Specialization (Warrior) talent granting a 20% threat reduction that does not stack with similar capstone bonuses.

Fanaticism now has a 7/14/20% threat reduction, down from 10/20/30%, while the increase to judgement critical strike chance has been increased to 6/12/18%, up from 4/8/12%.

Added capstone to the Soul Leech talent granting a buff when hit with a physical attack while casting any of the affected spells, guaranteeing a proc of Soul Leech and granting 30% increased crit chance on the casted spell.
Added capstone to the Healing Focus talent granting Stun duration reduction by 30% while casting any Shaman healing spell. This does not stack with other similar effects.
Last Stand now lasts 2 min, down from 3 min.
Mortal Strike now deals 5% reduced damage to players, from 10%.
Life Tap now grants 10% of maximum hp/mana (which ever is higher), down from 15%.

Improved Spirit Tap has been reworked. Now has a 100% chance with Shadow criticals and 50% chance on Mind Flay criticals to proc Spirit tap. In addition, grants 5/10% of your Spirit as spell haste rating.
Now grants 10/20/30% increased spirit and 25/50/75% mana regen continuing while casting, from 30/30/30% and 83/83/83%
Holy Concentration now has a duration of 12s, up from 8s.

Fixed Rapture to not always grant mana to the target, now instead gives all resources, but mana granted to the target has been reduced to 1% max mana, down from 2%. Now has an iCD of 6s, down from 12s.
Added capstone to the Test of Faith talent making you immune to Fear and Horror effects while casting Holy Priest healing spells.
Reduced the base mana cost of Wing Clip to 4%, down from 6% base mana.
Kill Command now has 4 stacks, up from 3, and each special pet ability reduces the damage by 10%, down from 20%.
